`interface DrawableRaster`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.raster` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DrawableRaster.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/raster/DrawableRaster.java)

The drawing of another renderer, which JOID runs into an offscreen framebuffer and then shows as an image.

## Description

Pass it to [`DrawRaster.drawRaster`](/reference/drawing/drawraster/#DrawRaster-method-drawRaster) as a lambda.

## Method details

<a id="DrawableRaster-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw(int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it on the render thread with the framebuffer bound, cleared to transparent, and a viewport of `width` × `height` screen pixels.
Draw there with your own graphics code, with premultiplied alpha; the projection maps one unit to one pixel, with `(0, 0)` at the top-left corner.
